Title: Junior Full Stack Developer
Company: CloudScale Dynamics
Location: Chicago, IL (Hybrid)
Experience: 0-2 years

About the Role:
We are seeking an enthusiastic Junior Full Stack Developer to build modern web applications and customer-facing dashboards.

Key Responsibilities:
- Build frontend interfaces using modern JavaScript (ES6+), React, and Tailwind CSS.
- Develop backend endpoints using Node.js and Express with PostgreSQL.
- Write unit tests using Jest and participate in Git code reviews.
- Collaborate with product designers and senior engineers in daily agile sprints.

Requirements:
- 0 to 2 years of professional software engineering experience.
- Strong foundational knowledge of JavaScript, React, and REST APIs.
- Familiarity with TypeScript and modern version control (Git).
- Excellent communication and eager attitude to learn in a fast-paced environment.
